technical.summary: GOOG shows bullish structure with new highs and momentum confirmation, but overbought conditions on multiple oscillators and weak trend confirmation limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional accumulation, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 39 days create a weak fundamental setup with elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional selling pressure from junior members combined with elevated market fear (43/100) presents mild contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and absence of senior conviction limits signal strength.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (400.0), flat yield curve, rising USD, and recent FOMC event create severely unfavourable macro conditions; earnings in 39 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull flip up, 20-day new high, and three white soldiers provide bullish structure with momentum confirmation in a fear-zone contrarian setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis regime, multiple overbought oscillators, weak trend confirmation across all moving average systems, no fundamental support, and earnings event risk in 39 days create a high-probability fade setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Hull flip and 20-day new high provide bullish structure, but overbought oscillators and weak trend confirmation severely limit entry quality in a crisis VIX regime.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX crisis environment (400.0) combined with multiple overbought conditions and earnings event risk in 39 days creates high probability of mean reversion fade.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias
